messages:
Amar: Heads-up — preview call with GateFlow tomorrow 9am PT to walk their marketplace credential flow and token-exchange. Want to align SI uplift plan + joint announcement embargo. 
Tess: on it. can you share preflight doc? :eyes: 
Amar: partners-bot created draft: https://go/redwood/docs/gateway-token-flow (work-in-progress). we'll need LangChain + LlamaIndex integration notes in there. 
Jules: For LangChain runner we need adapter parity tests — can we get GateFlow to expose a test harness? 
Kartik: I can sketch a quick harness. main ask: sample token-exchange handshake + replayable sessions. snippet below:
```
POST /token-exchange
{ "client_id": "si-123", "nonce": "abc" }
=> 200 { "delegated_token": "ey...", "ttl": 3600 }
```
Sloane: Also add a compatibility matrix row for orchestration tools (OrchX, GateOrch). SI teams will demand explicit rollout steps and rollback triggers. 
Amar: Good call. also need co-marketing checklist: press lead, legal signoff, cloud marketplace listing window, partner quotes. propose embargo window 48h pre-launch. thoughts? :calendar: 
Tess: 48h sounds tight for enterprise PR. can we do 72h? legal needs time. 
Jules: 72h + a 24h internal blackout for any config flips. we should schedule canary for small subset first. 
Kartik: SI uplift playbook draft: on-call Slack rotation, smoke test script, infra playbook, contact list. I'll post in the doc after call. 
Amar: OK — agenda for tomorrow: demo token flow, test harness access, compatibility matrix draft, embargo timeline (target 72h), and co-marketing owners. 
partners-bot: Meeting scheduled: 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z — calendar invite sent to attendees. 
Tess: I'll prep the LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter notes; aiming for a 1-pager. 
Sloane: I'll loop in legal + PR and start draft cloud marketplace entry requirements. 
Amar: thanks all — please add blockers to the doc. if nothing else, meet-up tomorrow. :thumbsup:
